item.title: Configuring Polaris
item.description:
Overview🔗

This page provides information on how to configure Apache Polaris. Unless stated otherwise, this information is valid both for Polaris Docker images (and Kubernetes deployments) as well as for Polaris binary distributions.

📝 Note

For Production tips and best practices, refer to Configuring Polaris for Production.

First off, Polaris server runs on Quarkus, and uses its configuration mechanisms. Read Quarkus configuration guide to get familiar with the basics.

item.title: Structured and Unstructured Table Locations
item.description:
Polaris supports two modes that decide where Iceberg tables and views may be located in a catalog:

  • Structured locations, the default. A table’s or view’s location must be inside the location of its namespace, and a table’s write.data.path and write.metadata.path must be inside the table’s own location.
  • Unstructured locations. Table and view locations, and write paths, may be anywhere inside the catalog’s allowed locations.

In both modes, all locations must be inside the catalog’s allowed locations. Unstructured locations are enabled by setting the feature ALLOW_UNSTRUCTURED_TABLE_LOCATION or the catalog property polaris.config.allow.unstructured.table.location to true.

item.title: Storage Layout
item.description:
This page explains where Polaris places namespaces, tables, and views in object storage, and how the settings that change this layout interact. Several of these settings have overlapping effects, and some combinations are rejected, so it is worth reading this page before changing any of them.

This page covers internal catalogs. Federated catalogs are served by a remote catalog, which owns the table locations, so none of the rules on this page apply to them. External catalogs without a federation connection store their tables in Polaris, but the locations are set by the system that updates them rather than generated by Polaris. Only some of the rules below apply to them, and the sections below note where they differ.
